decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler fits the firm's core heat exchanger competence, and with only one year of evidence there is no clear shortfall against aspirations to trigger problemistic search.
The air cooled condenser shares technology with the established cooler line, so carrying it costs little slack even though it may overlap with Product C.
As a near-duplicate of Product B it is the most likely candidate for consolidation, but too little time has passed to judge its results, so the firm keeps it for now.
The tube liner serves the stable repair and maintenance market with recurring demand, which supports performance near aspiration levels.
Customized air coolers are typical of a mature German Mittelstand engineering firm's core business and are unlikely to fall short of aspirations.
The tube end repair inserts complement the liner within the service portfolio and need little slack, so the firm continues them.
